summary: Two hikers (man and woman) stranded on the peak side of the Knife Edge on Capitol Peak when fast-moving weather (hail turning to snow, lightning) rolled in around noon; the woman's knees were giving out and she was unwilling to cross the wet Knife Edge, so the pair sheltered under an overhang and called for rescue; Mountain Rescue Aspen sent two field teams and the pair were brought back safely to a meadow near Capitol Lake around 5:30 p.m.
location: Peak side of the Knife Edge, Capitol Peak (near Capitol Lake)
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Army National Guard (helicopter)
notes: Date 2016-08-22 (Monday) verified via Vail Daily item dated 2016-08-23 stating the rescue was "Monday" and a 14ers.com forum post by one of the rescued climbers dated Tue Aug 23, 2016 8:33am describing the rescue as the prior afternoon; fills thin year 2016.
